objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Exploit the XML external entity weakness of a FastAPI profile page that accepts a profile image upload, including SVG files and read the flag in /app/flag.txt.
hints: Look at how the server parses the XML you send and whether external entities are resolved.
Check which properties of an upload the server validates, and where the stored file ends up.
